MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 would add a screen for video calls alongside my Fire TV setup, giving me a useful new capability.",
    "The Blink Video Doorbell fits my interest in home security because doorstep alerts and two-way conversations would complement the cameras I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV Stick or a Fire TV Cube would mostly repeat streaming functions already covered by my existing stick and Fire TV television.",
    "The AirPods, SSD enclosure, and charging cables do not address a current need; my electronics purchases do not mean I am looking for unrelated accessories.",
    "The camera bundle, Echo Dot, and Echo Show 5 have some appeal, but I would currently prefer a doorbell that adds coverage and the larger Echo Show 8 for easier viewing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to offer more streaming devices, even though I already have that function covered.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in earbuds, storage accessories, and charging cables without a specific use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters now is whether a device adds something useful to my existing home setup, such as doorstep communication or a screen for calls.",
    "Interest does not mean I would buy every related device: I would choose one larger smart display over several Alexa devices and a doorbell before another camera bundle."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home entertainment and security, but miss the distinction between useful additions and functions I already have."
}
